summary: Implemented prepareUpdate as specified, without running tests or installing anything (verified by reading only). Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: added an Update container with prologue and algebra attributes, beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns an Update; the empty-request path builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] via translatePrologue and returns an empty algebra list; the non-empty path wraps the result; Update is imported alongside Prologue and Query. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; docstring updated. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: added prepareUpdate after prepareQuery, setting _original_args. The string path and processUpdate are unchanged. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py: exports prepareUpdate. (6) test/test_sparql_prepare.py: new module covering all required behaviors, with a no-mutation check comparing [name, str(op)] snapshots. Not verified: the new tests, the DAWG tests, and the prepareQuery test have not been run; black formatting was checked only by line-length inspection (new code has no lines over 88 columns). No commits were made.
